critique.evidence: Standard-mode proof shows only one subtle opacity pulse on an 8px status dot across desktop, tablet, and mobile; no other motion choreography or interaction transition is measured. That pulse renders smoothly, with live-wire averages of 14.7–15.29ms and worst frames around 16.7ms. Overall timing reports zero long frames, though desktop reaches 19.31ms average and 33.4ms worst. Reduced-motion matches and produces zero changed elements, but still reports one active animation, so the animation is not demonstrably removed.
critique.fix: Fully disable the active animation under prefers-reduced-motion, then provide measured frame sequences for meaningful event-selection and detail-panel transitions across all viewports. Keep them transform/opacity-based, free of layout shifts, and within the demonstrated frame budget.
